summary: Examples of the debugger keyword on a task (on_failed), a play (on_skipped), and at multiple levels where a task's on_failed overrides the play's never.
questions: How do I enable the debugger on a single task?
Can I disable the debugger for a play but enable it for one task?

answer_card.title: debugger keyword examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Execute a command
  ansible.builtin.command: "false"
  debugger: on_failed
```

```yaml
- name: Play
  hosts: all
  debugger: never
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.command: "false"
      debugger: on_failed   # wins: debugger opens on failure
```
